items.title: 10,000 Black Interns Programme (Summer 2027 internships)
items.deadline_note: FAQ states applications close 1 November 2026; allocations communicated by end of November and continue until June 2027. Foundation homepage states applications are now open.
items.visa: Unrestricted right to work in the UK required at application.
items.notes: For Black African, Black Caribbean, Black British or mixed Black heritage students at UK universities (UG or PG) or 2024+ graduates who have not previously interned via the programme. Paid internships of 6+ weeks, mostly summer; workstreams include Economic Consulting, Investment Management, Markets and Corporate & Investment Banking.

items.title: GAIN Internship Programme 2027 (investment management)
items.deadline_note: 2027 application window stated as 7 September 2026 to 25 October 2026.
items.visa: Must have right to work full-time in the UK during the internship; no visa sponsorship.
items.notes: For young women and non-binary penultimate/final-year undergraduates (and Master's/MBA) of any degree on track for a 2:1. Paid summer internships at investment management firms with training and mentoring.

items.title: GAIN Insight Programme (first-years)
items.deadline_note: FAQ says applications open in autumn (year not stated); previous cycle's Spring Insight Days were 8-9 April 2026.
items.visa: Page states international students are not yet eligible.
items.notes: For women and non-binary first-year students (or second year of a four-year course) at UK universities, any subject. Insight into investment management careers, meeting investors and spring insight days.

items.title: GAIN On Demand - free investment management course
items.deadline_note: Self-paced online course; no deadline.
items.notes: Free online course (3 courses, ~35 lessons, ~30 hours) on investment management, no finance background needed. GAIN's programmes target young women and non-binary students.

items.title: Spring Into Finance (All Areas)
items.deadline_note: SEO's Spring Into page lists the deadline as 'October 2026' (no exact day). Apply via SEO portal urgently. SEO Spring Weeks run March-July 2027.
items.visa: International students eligible only if on long-term student/graduate visa and meet SEO background criteria.
items.notes: For first-year students from ethnic minority or low socio-economic backgrounds (state-educated) graduating 2027 or later. Multi-day programme introducing finance roles and firms, linked to spring week opportunities and pre-spring training.

items.title: Spring Into Finance (Buyside)
items.deadline_note: SEO lists deadline as 'April 2027' (no exact day).
items.visa: As per SEO Careers eligibility.
items.notes: First-year students meeting SEO eligibility (ethnic minority or low socio-economic background). Introduces buy-side careers (asset management, hedge funds, private markets).

items.title: SEO Academies (Finance, Consulting, Insurance and others)
items.deadline_note: Page says 2025/26 Academies closed and next open dates are 'Summer 2026'; no closing date published.
items.visa: As per SEO Careers eligibility.
items.notes: Selective programmes for penultimate-year students from ethnic minority or low socio-economic backgrounds: 20+ hours of content plus firm masterclasses to help secure a summer internship.

items.title: HerCapital
items.deadline_note: Page says applications open in January (year not stated).
items.notes: For SEO-eligible women in first year (any degree) who have not yet secured a spring week. Six-month mentoring and insight programme with sponsor-firm events, investing/coding workshops and Bloomberg accreditation.

items.title: SEO Accelerator (final-year)
items.deadline_note: Page states 'Applications Open: Summer 2026'; no closing date given.
items.notes: For final-year SEO-registered students who have completed at least one internship and 5+ hours of SEO events. Technical interview coaching, case studies and recommendations to firms for graduate roles.

items.title: Alternative Investments Programme (AIP)
items.deadline_note: No 2026/27 dates published on page.
items.notes: For students/young professionals from underserved and underrepresented backgrounds interested in private equity, credit, infrastructure, real estate and hedge funds. Technical training, mentoring and invitations to apply for associate roles.

items.title: SEO Elevate (free monthly online workshops)
items.deadline_note: Rolling monthly sessions booked via SEO student portal.
items.notes: Open to all university students. CV/interview, commercial awareness and industry fundamentals workshops; 5 hours unlocks SEO's more selective programmes.

items.title: SEO Pre-Internship Training
items.deadline_note: No dates published.
items.notes: For SEO-eligible students who already hold an internship or vacation scheme offer. Multi-day training and masterclasses to help convert the internship.

items.title: upReach undergraduate support programmes
items.deadline_note: Rolling applications; places fill quickly. No 2026/27 deadline found.
items.notes: Social mobility charity for full-time UK undergraduates from lower socio-economic backgrounds (household income evidence and contextualised grades via REALRating). Free coaching, employer events, internships and mentoring; first and penultimate years may be prioritised.

items.title: Rare candidate development programmes
items.deadline_note: No programme dates found on official site for 2026/27.
items.notes: Diversity recruitment firm offering candidates one-to-one development, expert advice and exclusive events with banks, consultancies and law firms; many programmes target Black and ethnic minority students and those from disadvantaged backgrounds. Check the site's Students/Apply sections for current programmes.

items.title: Internship Experience UK (IEUK) - virtual 4-day programme
items.deadline_note: 2026 edition closed (final deadline 9 June 2026; ran 15-18 June 2026). 2027 dates not yet announced.
items.notes: Free virtual internship for first, second and penultimate-year undergraduates, with streams including Finance, Professional Services and Consulting. Not restricted by background; open to all Bright Network members.

items.title: Bright Network FESTIVAL 2026
items.deadline_note: Event took place 11 September 2026; applications closed 6 September 2026. Watch for 2027 edition.
items.notes: Free in-person careers festival with ~80 employers for UK university students graduating 2027-2030. Useful for networking ahead of the next cycle.

items.title: 93% Students network and jobs board
items.deadline_note: Free membership, no deadline.
items.notes: Free network for state-educated students. Offers events, employer opportunities, a student Slack community and a jobs board (careers.93percent.club).

items.title: The Skills Workshop (investment & savings careers)
items.deadline_note: Search summary of official page indicated 2026 virtual workshops run June to October 2026; could not load page directly to confirm.
items.notes: Free virtual workshops run by #TalkAboutBlack with CFA Society UK and investment firms, open to all with a focus on ethnic minority and socially disadvantaged students. Covers the investment industry, CVs and interviews.

items.title: Aleto Leadership Programme
items.deadline_note: No dates published; join the waiting list.
items.notes: Intensive multi-day leadership programme for 19-25 year olds from low socio-economic backgrounds, hosted with corporate partners; alumni get mentoring.

items.title: Future Talent Network
items.deadline_note: Applications open in cohort windows; no 2026 dates published.
items.notes: For 18-25s from undergraduate to early career, from underrepresented/low-income backgrounds; STEM-focused. Internship/placement pipeline and graduate scheme partnerships with FTSE 100 employers - relevance to economics depends on quantitative/tech interests.

items.title: Experience Finance (free Finance Accelerator simulations)
items.deadline_note: Free on-demand/live simulations; no fixed deadline found.
items.notes: Free trading, banking and quant simulations open to students; top performers can be flagged as High Potential Candidates and fast-tracked to industry contacts. Not restricted by background.

items.title: GAIN University Investment Challenge 2026
items.deadline_note: Applications opened 20 April 2026 (team registration likely closed). Challenge launched 8 Oct 2026; presentation deadline 8 Nov 2026; live finals 8-9 Dec 2026.
items.visa: International students may enter.
items.notes: Free team competition (up to 5) for women and non-binary students in any year/subject who are members of a GAIN-partnered university society. Workshops, judging and mentoring for top teams.

items.title: CFA Institute Research Challenge 2026-27
items.location: UK local round; EMEA regional; global final Singapore
items.deadline_note: Teams start in autumn via university faculty advisor; regional semifinals 6-7 Apr 2027, regional finals 8-9 Apr 2027, global final week of 10 May 2027. Local UK deadlines not published.
items.notes: Equity research competition for teams of 3-5 UG/PG students registered by their university with a faculty advisor. SOAS students should ask the Economics department whether SOAS enters a team.

items.title: AI Investment Challenge (UK)
items.deadline_note: Inaugural UK edition held 30 April 2026; no future dates announced - join the waitlist.
items.notes: University teams of 3-5 (UG or PG) apply AI to investment problems; 2026 prizes were GBP 2,000/1,200/800 plus CFA Program Access Scholarships for finalists.

items.title: Bloomberg Global Trading Challenge
items.deadline_note: Bloomberg said registration for the next challenge opens September 2026; no deadline found. Requires faculty-led team and Terminal access.
items.notes: Teams of 3-5 students led by a faculty advisor manage a virtual USD 1m equity portfolio on the Bloomberg Terminal. Ask SOAS whether it has Terminal access/enters teams.

items.title: IMC Prosperity global trading challenge
items.deadline_note: Prosperity 4 ran April 2026. 2027 edition not announced; past editions ran in spring.
items.notes: Algorithmic and manual trading game for university students, solo or teams up to 5, with cash prizes. The 2025 edition was restricted to STEM students; check whether Economics qualifies.

items.title: LSESU Economics Challenge (with ASEEDER)
items.deadline_note: Page says next cycle opens late 2026; registration deadline not yet set. Eligibility for undergraduates not stated.
items.notes: Multiple-choice competition on economic theory and policy run by LSE's student Economics Society. Confirm undergraduate eligibility when the new cycle opens.

items.title: Undergraduate Policy Competition
items.deadline_note: 2025 edition closed (essay deadline 5 Oct 2025). No 2026/27 round published yet.
items.notes: Policy essay plus finalist presentation, open to current undergraduates at any university worldwide.

items.title: SOAS Careers Service
items.location: London (Senate House North Block SL62) / Online
items.notes: One-to-one careers guidance, application/interview advice, practice interviews, employer events and digital resources (GoinGlobal, Graduates First, CareerSet). Contact careers@soas.ac.uk.

items.title: CareersZONE (SOAS jobs board and events booking)
items.notes: SOAS's careers management system where all vacancies, internships (paid at least minimum wage) and volunteering roles are posted, plus event and appointment booking and e-learning pathways.

items.title: Jobs, internships and volunteering (SOAS guidance)
items.notes: SOAS page explaining how to find jobs, internships and volunteering through CareersZONE, including remote opportunities.

items.title: Working for GES - student and graduate routes
items.visa: Civil Service Nationality Rules apply.
items.notes: Overview of GES routes for economics students: Summer Student Scheme, Sandwich Student Placement Scheme, Assistant Economist Scheme and Fast Stream. (GES placements are covered separately - note search results indicate the 2026 placement window closes 16 Oct 2026.)

items.title: GES Hub - Government Economic Service careers
items.notes: Civil Service Careers hub on working as a government economist, with how-to-apply guidance for the Assistant Economist scheme.

items.title: Role profile: economist
items.notes: Civil Service role profile and career pathway for government economists.

items.title: Civil Service Jobs
items.visa: Civil Service Nationality Rules apply.
items.notes: Official Civil Service vacancy site where government departments advertise economist and analyst roles year-round; search 'economist'.

items.title: Bright Network (jobs, internships, advice)
items.notes: Free early-careers platform with internship/graduate job board, application calendar, Career Path Test, webinars and first-year opportunities guide.

items.title: Targetjobs: Accountancy, banking and finance sector guide
items.notes: Sector guides, job descriptions (investment analyst, trader, fund manager), salary info and 2027 graduate listings for finance careers.

items.title: Prospects job profile: Economist
items.notes: Role, salary, entry requirements and main employers for economists. See also 'What can I do with an economics degree?' at https://www.prospects.ac.uk/careers-advice/what-can-i-do-with-my-degree/economics/.

items.title: RateMyPlacement: economics placements and internships
items.notes: Search of undergraduate economics placements, internships and vacation schemes, plus student reviews of employers.

items.title: Trackr UK Finance tracker
items.notes: Tracks open/close dates for UK finance spring weeks, summer and off-cycle internships; free account with some features behind Premium. Its forecast dates are estimates - verify on employer sites.

items.title: Discover Economics careers resources
items.notes: RES campaign to widen access to economics; careers-in-economics guides, sector posters and diverse economist role models. Mainly aimed at schools but useful for exploring economist roles.

items.title: SPE student membership
items.notes: Reduced-rate membership for UK undergraduates/Master's students studying economics: monthly seminars, masterclasses and access to the annual conference - good for networking with professional economists.

items.title: Change 100 paid summer internships for disabled students and graduates
items.deadline_note: No 2026/27 application window or deadline found. Since 15 November 2025 the programme is run by Ability Pathways (Ingeus); applications are made via their site. Register interest and check the official page.
items.visa: Most recent FAQ (2025) requires the right to work in the UK.
items.notes: Paid summer internships with inclusive employers plus professional development and mentoring for students and recent graduates with a disability or long-term health condition (per the 2025 FAQ). Confirm eligibility and dates on the Ability Pathways application page.

items.title: Spring Programme / Divisional Spring Insight 2027 (London)
items.deadline_note: No 2027 spring listing found on higher.gs.com as of 15 Oct 2026; previous cycles' spring listings now expired. Check higher.gs.com regularly.
items.notes: Past London spring programmes were for first-years on 3-year degrees, hosted by divisions including Investment Banking, Global Investment Research, Asset Management, Operations and Engineering. The url is GS's careers portal (higher.gs.com); search 'Spring' there.

items.title: 2027 Summer Analyst – Investment Banking (Classic / Capital Solutions Group), London
items.deadline_note: Official role page gives no closing date; third-party sites claim the EMEA window closed around 20 Sep 2026 – check live status on higher.gs.com.
items.notes: 9–10 week summer internship for penultimate-year students. You can apply to at most 4 business/location combinations per recruiting year; extra applications are auto-withdrawn. Capital Solutions Group listing: https://higher.gs.com/roles/170927.

items.title: 2027 Summer Analyst – Global Investment Research (Equity Research), London
items.deadline_note: No closing date on official listing; counts towards the 4-application limit.
items.notes: Research division internship, a good fit for Economics students interested in sector/macro analysis. 9–10 weeks, same 4-application rule as other GS summer roles.

items.title: 2027 New Analyst Programme (graduate), London
items.deadline_note: Only a 2027 New Analyst role in Birmingham (Legal) was seen; London 2027 New Analyst roles not confirmed. Most GS analysts are hired from the summer programme.
items.notes: Full-time programme for final-year undergraduates and graduate students. Linked listing is the Birmingham Legal New Analyst role; check higher.gs.com for London divisions.

items.title: 2027 Spring Insights (Advise & Invest / Analyse & Trade / Influence & Execute / Engineer & Innovate), London
items.deadline_note: Listings and trackers show a 1 Nov 2026 deadline, but programmes close as positions fill, so apply early.
items.notes: Hybrid format with panels, simulations and skills exercises, for students graduating in 2029. You may apply to only ONE Spring Insights track. Advise & Invest (IB and advisory) or Analyse & Trade (markets) suits Economics students.

items.title: 2027 Investment Banking Summer Analyst, London
items.deadline_note: A tracker shows a London IB intern role listed about 45 days ago; no official deadline verified. UK bank summer deadlines are typically Oct–Nov and rolling.
items.notes: Penultimate-year summer programme. Apply ASAP via the JPMorganChase careers portal. A HireVue video interview usually follows the online application.

items.title: 2027 Global Corporate Banking Analyst Program Summer Internship (Public Sector / International ABL), London
items.deadline_note: The International ABL listing shows a 1 Nov 2026 deadline; classes fill on a rolling basis.
items.notes: For students graduating between Jan and Aug 2028 who are on track for a 2:1. Corporate banking and lending track, often less competitive than the core IB internship. A HireVue interview follows the application review.

items.title: 2027 Investment Banking Summer Analyst Programme, London
items.deadline_note: Several third-party listings give an 18 Oct 2026 deadline; recruitment is rolling. Could not verify on morganstanley.com because the site did not load.
items.notes: 10-week IBD programme with a week of classroom training in mid-June, then placement in an IBD group. All assessment centres are in London. URGENT: deadline is only days away.

items.title: 2027 Company & ISG Spring Insight, London
items.deadline_note: Not yet open according to trackers. The 2025 ISG/MSIM spring insight closed 27 Oct 2024 and the 2026 date shown was 14 Jan 2026, so the timing varies.
items.notes: Held at Canary Wharf, for first-years on 3-year degrees (or second-years on 4-year degrees). Covers Institutional Securities divisions.

items.title: Banking Summer Internship Programme 2027, London
items.deadline_note: No closing date stated. The listing may close early due to application volumes, so apply ASAP.
items.visa: Barclays accepts applicants needing sponsorship and will sponsor a Skilled Worker visa if Home Office criteria are met. Otherwise you need full-time UK right to work Jun–Aug 2027.
items.notes: 10-week programme (June–Aug 2027) in industry, product or country coverage groups, working on modelling, valuation and pitch materials. Open to penultimate- or final-year students of any discipline.

items.title: Investing and Lending Summer Internship Programme 2027, London
items.deadline_note: No closing date published; rolling, may close early.
items.visa: See listing. Barclays' summer listings generally state Skilled Worker sponsorship is available to eligible candidates.
items.notes: 10-week programme for penultimate-year students covering relationship lending, credit analysis and sustainability-linked structuring.

items.title: Discovery Programme (spring insight, leads to 2027 internships), UK
items.deadline_note: No dates on the official page; register interest. A tracker shows the last cycle opened about 1 Dec 2025.
items.notes: For students two years from graduation (i.e. first-years on 3-year degrees). Gives a first look at Barclays' businesses; participants may be considered for an internship.

items.title: Investment Banking Graduate Analyst Programme 2027 (Expert programme), London
items.deadline_note: No 2027 London graduate listing or dates seen; most hires come from interns. Check the job search link on the page.
items.notes: Open to any degree background. Related tracks include Capital Markets, Investing & Lending, Markets, Research and International Corporate Banking graduate programmes.

items.title: Relationship Management – Commercial Bank – Internship 2027, London
items.deadline_note: Advertised close date was 18 Oct 2026; the official listing now says 'Sorry, this position has been filled'. Manchester, Glasgow, Reading and Cambridge RM internships are still in the programme finder (open 1 Oct, close 1 Nov 2026).
items.notes: Commercial/corporate banking, not core IB, but a strong route into banking. Regional RM internships (Manchester, Glasgow, Reading, Cambridge) close 1 Nov 2026 per HSBC's programme finder.

items.title: Global Investment Research – Work Placement 2027, London
items.deadline_note: Advertised close was 1 Nov 2026, but the official listing now says 'Sorry, this position has been filled' (19 Oct 2026) and it no longer appears in the programme finder.
items.notes: Corporate & Institutional Banking research placement, a good fit for Economics students. Check the listing for placement length: 'Work Placement' at HSBC is often longer than a summer internship.

items.title: Relationship Management – Commercial Bank – Graduate 2027 (Manchester / Glasgow)
items.deadline_note: Advertised close date was 18 Oct 2026; the official listing now says 'Sorry, this position has been filled'.
items.notes: Commercial banking graduate scheme outside London. Check the HSBC programme finder for London Global Banking & Markets graduate roles, which were not visible at check time.

items.title: Spring Insight Programme 2027, UK
items.deadline_note: Not yet listed; a tracker shows the last cycle opened about 4 Nov 2025.
items.notes: First-year insight programme. Watch the HSBC programme finder from November.

items.title: Banking, Financing, Summer Analyst, London 2027
items.deadline_note: Official listing (posting date now shown as 16 Oct 2026): rolling recruitment, 'There is no deadline for applications' – apply early.
items.notes: 10-week programme starting June with a week of training. For penultimate- or final-year students, any degree, 2:1 expected.

items.title: Banking, Investment Banking Summer Analyst 2027 (Real Estate, FIG; plus Citi Research), London
items.deadline_note: Real Estate and FIG summer analyst roles were listed on Citi's London student jobs page at check time. The general IB summer analyst listing now returns 404 (possibly closed).
items.notes: The same page also lists 'Client – Citi Research, Summer Analyst, London 2027' and Services summer analyst roles. Many full-time 2027 analyst roles are restricted to 2026 summer intern converts.

items.title: 2027 Spring Insight (1st Year Programme) – Banking / Markets, London
items.deadline_note: Not yet posted on Citi's London student jobs page as of 19 Oct 2026. The 2026 Markets spring insight was posted 27 Oct 2025, so a late Oct/Nov 2026 posting is likely but unconfirmed.
items.notes: Previous cycle: 4-day in-person programme in London with separate divisional applications (IB, Markets, etc.). Linked url is the 2026 listing, as a reference for format. Citi also runs a Social Mobility Network insight programme (posted around March).

items.title: Global Investment Banking 2027 Summer Analyst, London
items.deadline_note: Official listing showed apply-by 11 Oct 2026; the page now returns 404.
items.notes: Closed. Other 2027 London summer analyst roles (e.g. GM Credit, Global Corporate Banking) and off-cycle IB internships may still be open; check careers.bankofamerica.com student job search.

items.title: Spring Insight Week 2027 – London (Banking & Markets + Corporate Functions)
items.deadline_note: Register-interest stage. The 2026 programme deadline was 23 Nov 2025, so expect a similar window.
items.notes: Previously a 3-day in-person event for first-years on 3-year degrees, covering IB, corporate banking, GPS and S&T. Strong participants are considered for the following year's summer internship.

items.title: Graduate Programme – Investment Bank: Capital Markets / IBCM (UK Coverage) 2027, London
items.deadline_note: Third-party listing states 11 Oct 2026, 11:59pm deadline, so likely closed. Verify on careers.db.com; other DB 2027 graduate tracks may differ.
items.visa: Start subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.
items.notes: Official eligibility: finish studies 1 Jan 2026–31 Jul 2027, start July 2027, max 12 months' relevant experience. Only ONE DB application per UK recruitment season, so choose carefully.

items.title: Spring into Banking 2027 (plus Advance, GROW, Rise), UK
items.deadline_note: No 2027 dates on the official page; a tracker shows the last cycle opened about 4 Nov 2025.
items.notes: 4-day programmes for first-years, any degree. Advance is for lower socio-economic backgrounds, GROW for women and Rise for students of Black heritage. Check eligibility for these diversity streams.

items.title: Tomorrow's Talent & Spring Insight Program 2027, London
items.deadline_note: Tracker shows open 1 Oct, deadline 31 Oct 2026; not confirmed on ubs.com.
items.notes: For students graduating in 2029 who are on track for a 2:1, any subject. EMEA format is 4 days in person with AmplifyME simulations across Global Banking, Markets, Research and more. Strong performers are considered for the 2028 summer internship. Online tests must be done within 7 days of invitation.

items.title: Discover Nomura Insight Programme 2027 (plus Women's Immersion Programme)
items.deadline_note: Tracker gives a 10 Jan 2027 deadline; Nomura recruits on a rolling basis and may close early. Discover runs 5–6 Apr 2027.
items.notes: Unpaid 2-day insight into IB or Global Markets for students graduating in 2029. It can fast-track you to 2028 summer internship interviews. The SEO Explore Nomura programme is via SEO London membership only.

items.title: Investment Banking / Global Markets Summer Internship 2027, London
items.deadline_note: No 2027 dates found. Each vacancy on nomuracampus.tal.net lists its own deadline; rolling.
items.notes: 9–10 week programmes starting in June. IB interns join a sector or Client Financing & Solutions team; Markets interns do two desk rotations.

items.title: 2027 London Financial Advisory Spring Insight Programme
items.deadline_note: Official Lazard UK early careers page: 2027 Spring Insight applications open 19 Oct and close 15 Nov 2026. Rolling review; the process closes once all places are filled, so apply early.
items.visa: Lazard states it will sponsor eligible candidates for work visas (2026-cycle FAQ).
items.notes: 3-day programme with M&A workshops, an analyst 1:1, technical training and a group case study. Minimum predicted 2:1. Only one London Financial Advisory application per year.

items.title: 2027 London Financial Advisory Summer Internship
items.deadline_note: Official Lazard UK early careers page: 2027 intern applications opened 8 Sep and closed 4 Oct 2026.
items.visa: Lazard sponsors eligible candidates for work visas (2026-cycle FAQ).

items.title: 2027 London Financial Advisory Full-Time Analyst
items.deadline_note: Official Lazard UK early careers page: 2027 Analyst applications open 21 Sep and close 24 Oct 2026. Rolling review; may close earlier once roles are filled. Apply via Lazard's student careers portal linked from the page.
items.visa: Lazard sponsors eligible candidates for work visas (2026-cycle FAQ).
items.notes: For final-year undergraduates or recent graduates. Analyst training starts late July. Only one London FA application per year.

items.title: 2027 UK Global Advisory Spring Insight Programme
items.deadline_note: Rolling, no fixed close date; apply early.
items.notes: 4-day London programme for first-years graduating in 2029 who are on track for a 2:1. Includes shadowing junior bankers across M&A, Debt & Restructuring and equity advisory. Strong performers get a fast-track to the 2028 summer internship.

items.title: 2027 UK Global Advisory Women's Horizon Insight Programme, London
items.deadline_note: Rolling, no fixed close date.
items.notes: 4-day spring 2027 programme for female students in any year of study, including Master's.

items.title: 2027 UK Global Advisory Summer Analyst Programme – London
items.deadline_note: Rolling, no close date; opened Aug 2026, so apply immediately.
items.notes: 10 weeks from June 2027 with technical training, then M&A or Debt & Restructuring. Can lead to a graduate offer. Separate 2027 summer programmes exist for GFS & Restructuring, ECM, Arrowpoint, Wealth Management, Redburn and regional offices.

items.title: Evergreen – 2027 Global Advisory Graduate Programme, London
items.deadline_note: Official page: 'not currently recruiting for our 2027 UK Graduate Programme' – not an open vacancy, but you can register interest.
items.notes: Hiring paused after a strong intern pipeline. Evergreen applicants will be considered first if it reopens. July 2027 start with 6-week global training.

items.title: 2027 London Summer Internship (Debt Advisory / RESA / Restructuring)
items.deadline_note: Official page: applications ran 31 Aug–11 Oct 2026.

items.title: 2027 London Full-Time Analyst (RESA / Restructuring)
items.deadline_note: Official page: applications ran 31 Aug–11 Oct 2026.
items.notes: Five weeks of training, then typically two 9-month rotations.

items.deadline_note: PJT says Europe summer applications open in September and close in October. A PCS listing showed an 11 Oct 2026 deadline, so most are likely closed. Check Workday.
items.notes: 10-week programme across the Strategic Advisory and Restructuring groups. Penultimate-year students (recent graduates also accepted in Europe). Includes the 'Suited' online assessment. Off-cycle Jan–May 2027 roles also posted.

items.notes: Not described on PJT's own students page; contact CampusRecruitingEurope@pjtpartners.com to confirm.

items.visa: Not stated for internships. Graduate schemes do not sponsor visas, so check before applying.
items.notes: For penultimate-year students. Business areas are not listed on the page.

items.title: Global Banking and Advisory 2027 Summer Internship (8 weeks), London

items.title: IFS Research Economist (graduate entry)
items.deadline_note: The BeApplied posting linked from the IFS jobs page closes at 11:55pm GMT on 8 November 2026. Exact opening date not stated (IFS says recruitment began in early October 2026).
items.visa: The posting says the role is eligible for a Skilled Worker visa and IFS will support the application where needed.
items.notes: Open to final-year students expecting an extremely good degree in economics (or with a significant economics component). New graduates start on GBP 44,500, and IFS funds part-time master's study. Very competitive.

items.title: IfG Research Internship 2027-28 (12-month paid graduate internship)
items.deadline_note: The official page says applications for 2027-28 will open in spring 2027; the 2026-27 round is closed.
items.visa: Not stated on the official page; a third-party listing claims IfG cannot sponsor visas (unverified).
items.notes: Paid 12-month research internship starting September, working on civil service, public finances, devolution and similar; needs to be London-based. Sign up to the IfG recruitment mailing list.

items.title: Research Training Programme (12-week placement for recent graduates)
items.deadline_note: The official page says the training programme is now closed and the Foundation is not currently recruiting.
items.visa: Not stated.
items.notes: For Black, Asian and minority ethnic graduates and graduates with a disability who are interested in economic policy analysis. Watch for a future round.

items.org: National Institute of Economic and Social Research (NIESR)
items.title: NIESR vacancies - no student/graduate scheme
items.deadline_note: The careers page says there are no vacancies at the moment; it accepts speculative CVs to hr@niesr.ac.uk.
items.visa: Not stated.
items.notes: No formal internship or graduate programme; junior research roles are advertised ad hoc, including on jobs.ac.uk.

items.title: World Bank Group Internship Program
items.deadline_note: The official page says Spring/Summer cycle applications run January-February and Winter/Fall July-August. No year-specific deadline is given.
items.visa: Must be a citizen of a WBG member country (the UK and most countries are members). Mostly based outside the UK.
items.notes: Final-year undergraduates are eligible only for specific undergraduate-designated roles (e.g. Treasury intern); most internships want postgraduates.

items.title: OECD Internship Programme (rolling)
items.location: Mainly Paris; some hybrid or remote
items.deadline_note: Rolling: the OECD recruits interns year-round. Selection can take up to three months, so apply well ahead of when you are available.
items.visa: Internships are primarily allocated to nationals of OECD member countries (the UK is one); non-member nationals are considered for specific programmes. You must be enrolled in a full-time degree for the whole internship.
items.notes: 1-6 month internships (renewable to 12) open to bachelor's, master's and PhD students; most interns are postgraduates. Pays EUR 1,000 per full month for Paris-based interns; needs excellent English or French.

items.title: ECB Traineeship Programme
items.deadline_note: Rolling vacancy notices on the ECB career portal; no cycle dates.
items.visa: EU member state or acceding-country nationals only. UK-only nationals are NOT eligible.
items.notes: Requires a completed bachelor's degree (so for graduates, not current undergrads) and English plus another EU language. The ECB Graduate Programme requires a master's.

items.title: BIS Graduate Programme (up to 11 months)
items.deadline_note: Official page says opportunities are usually advertised in spring; no 2027 dates published.
items.visa: Open to all nationalities.
items.notes: For recent or soon-to-be graduates with a bachelor's or master's and strong analytical skills; non-renewable contract in Basel. No undergraduate internship is listed.
